description: Defines a generic grain class 'SimpleGenericGrain<TType>' implementing 'ISimpleGenericGrain<TType>' interface, with methods for setting, getting, transforming, and comparing grain references within Orleans framework.

classes.name: SimpleGenericGrain<TType>
classes.description: A generic Orleans grain class with methods to set, get, transform, and compare grain references.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the value of the grain's internal property.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Performs a transformation or operation; implementation currently does nothing.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the current value stored in the grain.

methods.name: CompareGrainReferences
methods.description: Compares the grain's reference with a client-provided reference and throws an exception if they differ.
